statement: Setting key50 is SLEEP_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT (u16 little-endian value), with default 900 and legal 0..32767 in a published replacement firmware registry; key9 is LIZARD_MODE. The C6 codec rejects key50 atomically. This is a plausible Steam claim failure but host-origin not distinguished from kernel and no Steam-side rejection logic is public.
